stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Michael Avramovic on 21 pts - minor premiership form, and unlike Fremantle they don't have to face Hawthorn

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 40 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: The Great Escape
stories.detail: Dianne McAlister finished 15 pts - out of the blue-ball zone at the death, relief all round

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 2 off the pace

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Off the stick (6) and 8th - proper ball-striking

stories.title: The Phoenix
stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 8 & 9 - drama then redemption

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 6 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 7 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 7, 8 & 9

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 5, 6 & 7 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 6 & 7

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 5 straight two-pointers on holes 3-7

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 3 & 4 - this is momentum

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 5 & 6 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: The Grind
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers in a row on holes 2, 3 & 4

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 3, wipe on hole 4 - the course corrects

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 1 & 2 - the course charges a fee for everything
